_how: Don's to-do, shown first on the HTML dashboard. Don, 2026-10-15: "If I ever ask what I need to do then add it to my dashboard." Whenever he asks what he needs to do, add each step here; remove it the moment it is done. Fields: p (1 = do first, 2, 3), text (what), how (one line), due (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), unlocks (what it unblocks, optional), url (optional), added (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.how: Phone, socialus.org, signed in with your SECOND email (enter the 6-digit code from the email). Open a Page your main account owns, tap ⋯ beside the share icon → Report this Page, pick any reason except Sensitive content, Send. Then sign in as your main account, open You: a courtesy notice should be there, and the Page is still fully visible. Report the same Page again from the second account: only the name and description disappear for others, the Page stays up. Also check your own Page shows no Report in its ⋯ (needs PR #938 merged).
items.unlocks: Closes web #220, clears the 10-27 photo tripwire, and proves the AI shadow read runs (#486)

items.text: Outer counties: A, B or C
items.how: Pick on the Issue; recommended A.
items.unlocks: Pages in Lodi, Vacaville, Yuba City and Grass Valley

items.text: Turn on Vercel Speed Insights (free tier)

sentry.io → create a Next.js project → text Dispatch the DSN; Dispatch puts it in Vercel.

items.text: Look at the new Explore on your phone
items.how: Open Explore: Pages and posts are mixed (megaphone = post). Tap the filter icon, pick Posts and This weekend, then a Category; the list should narrow.

items.how: Read and decide on the plan PR.

items.text: Should members be able to mark a post as a deal or last-minute?
items.how: Yes or no on the Issue. Today only the sample posts have those kinds, so Explore's Deals and Last-minute filters show samples only.
items.unlocks: The Deals and Last-minute filters work for real posts

items.text: AI shadow window: extend past 10-27, or end it
items.how: The window runs 10-13 to 10-27; few reports so far, so extending is likely. Your call on 10-27.

items.text: Wording: 'we do not tolerate abusive content'
items.how: Give the sentence you want members to see. The verified-phone part stays parked with Twilio (web #707).

items.text: HUD account and token for web #849
items.how: Register a free user at huduser.gov (USPS crosswalk API), then text Dispatch the token; Dispatch puts it in Vercel and the repo secrets.

items.text: Review the 8 grade card pass bars (and the weekly-email question)

items.how: Safari → socialus.org → Share → Add to Home Screen. Open SocialUs from the Home Screen, sign in, You → Alerts → turn on New posts from Pages I follow → Allow. Follow a Page; when it posts you get one.

items.how: Resend → Domains → add socialus.org and add the DNS records it shows; then GitHub → socialus-web → Settings → Secrets → Actions: add RESEND_API_KEY (your Resend key) and FOLLOW_EMAIL_FROM (SocialUs <reminders@socialus.org>).
items.unlocks: Remind me reaches members by email when they haven't turned on notifications (push reminders already work)
